title: Virago
program: Louis le Prince International Short Film Competition
description: In Virago village, no man is allowed to live past his fortieth birthday. Tõnu is about to turn forty and his wife is determined to break the cycle of early male death.
cast: Marje Metsur A man locates his stolen bicycle but it now appears to be in the ownership of an absolute stranger. He attempts to retrieve the bike but finds himself caught up in a web of miscommunication and mistrust. Is it possible for him to remain humane?
